# self-update: improve interaction and DX with gum

Make `self-update` interactive and pleasant with [gum](https://github.com/charmbracelet/gum) (prompts, choosers, spinners, styled output) and record a how-to with [vhs](https://github.com/charmbracelet/vhs). **Motivation:** "current implementation is boring and non-interactive" — a long wall of `brew`/`docker`/`go` output with no progress indication and no way to pick targets after starting.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/556#issuecomment-5711707565
Code vs intent: `gum` was added for this ticket and is used by `books()` (`bin/lib/sys/path.bash`), but after the 2025 Brewfile split `gum` is declared only in `candidates.Brewfile`; since `self-update brew` removes undeclared formulae (`--force-cleanup`), `books` ends up failing with "command not found: gum" wherever `gum` was not reinstalled by hand. Either declare `gum` again or guard `books`.
-->
